Our starting line for 2028.

These are the 2024 results we build on. Every new member, branch executive and polling agent moves these numbers.

Source: December 2024 results as published by Graphic Online and GhanaWeb.

24,970

Oforikrom votes for President John Dramani Mahama in 2024, a 35.2% share.

33.7%

NDC share of the parliamentary vote, 24,483 votes.

15

Electoral areas across four zonal councils, each with its own branches.

The Reset agenda

Resetting Ghana, felt in Oforikrom.

The NDC government's programme, and what it means in our markets, on our streets and on campus.

The 24-Hour Economy

Shifts, not shutdowns. The plan keeps production, markets and services running around the clock. For traders in Ayigya, Anloga and Bomso, that means longer trading hours and more jobs.

What it means for our markets
Launched July 2025

No-Fees-Stress

Government pays first-year academic fees at public tertiary institutions, including for KNUST freshers.

Women's Development Bank

Affordable credit for women-owned businesses, from market stalls to small shops.

Free Primary Healthcare

Removing the cost barrier to basic care at public health facilities, so families seek treatment early.

The Big Push

A national infrastructure drive to build and repair the roads that connect communities, jobs and markets.

KNUST is in Oforikrom. So is the next generation of the party.

One of Ghana's largest universities sits inside our constituency. TEIN-KNUST and the Youth Wing give students and young workers a real say in the party.
